Mike's own, MIT (its pyproject.toml). Optional: reused read-only through atlas_vfx/_atlas_scene.py, only by Physical Sky (catalogue 48) to render the Prague sky (atlas_scene.environment + its atlas_scene_prague extension). Atlas Scene owns the sky; nothing of it is copied here. Version and git commit go into every Physical Sky info / sidecar.

Prague Sky Model C++ implementation (Wilkie et al. 2021, Vevoda et al. 2022), Copyright 2022 Charles University, Apache-2.0. Not vendored here: Atlas Scene vendors it in integrations/prague/vendor/pragueskymodel at upstream commit 2385c912e9051c1258013ff8c3ce2e19e10fb917 (github.com/PetrVevoda/pragueskymodel) and compiles it into atlas_scene_prague._native. Verified 2026-10-28: SPDX-License-Identifier Apache-2.0 in PragueSkyModel.h, upstream LICENSE.txt is Apache 2.0, and the sha256 of PragueSkyModel.h / .cpp / LICENSE.txt match Atlas Scene's integrations/prague/THIRD_PARTY.md pins; the GitHub repo page lists Apache-2.0. Used by Physical Sky only, through Atlas Scene.

Prague Sky Model precomputed datasets, Apache-2.0 per the authors' Zenodo record 10.5281/zenodo.19140728 (Wilkie, Vevoda, Hosek, Bashford-Rogers, Iser, Kolarova, Rittig, Krivanek; v1.0.0, 2026-03-20; checked 2026-10-28). The GitHub README links the same three files on Google Drive and states no separate data licence, so the Zenodo record is the licence source. Not redistributed by atlas-vfx or Atlas Scene; the node reads the file named by its dataset widget or ATLAS_PRAGUE_DATASET. On ws (atlas-scene-DEV/praguesky_models): SkyModelDatasetGround.dat, 107,632,816 bytes, md5 953864f62c9434269b7f909cdff6c7cd = Zenodo's PragueSkyModelDatasetGround.dat, sha256 76bd619dc6dfcbc900c2996436dd6cf68197c03e3982fe5580f2b109ce1c71c2 (the one Physical Sky uses: ground level, no altitude, no polarisation); SkyModelDataset.dat, 2,397,370,196 bytes, md5 dcfa2bd165cf803c1791c469e05d134c = Zenodo's PragueSkyModelDatasetFull.dat (altitude + polarisation).

three.js r185 (npm three 0.185.0), MIT, Copyright 2010-2026 three.js authors, bundled as one ES module with three/examples' fflate 0.8.2 (MIT). Vendored (shipped) as web/lib/atlas-three.bundle.js, used only by the Sun Globe panel (web/atlas_vfx_sun_globe.js, Physical Sky, catalogue 48); display only, no node needs it. Copied byte for byte from Atlas Camera at e2f8d38 (atlas_camera/comfy/web/lib/atlas-three.bundle.js, vendored there in 1b630f0), with a provenance comment added on top; no CDN, no import from the Atlas Camera pack. Licence verified 2026-10-29: the bundle's own embedded licence block (three.core.js / three.module.js SPDX-License-Identifier MIT, fflate 'Licensed under MIT', version 0.8.2), Atlas Camera's ui/node_modules/three/package.json (version 0.185.0, license MIT) and its LICENSE (copied as web/lib/three.LICENSE), and the LICENSE on github.com/mrdoob/three.js (MIT, 'Copyright 2010-2026 three.js authors'). tests/test_sun_globe.py checks the hash.
